notes: «أن زيد بن أسلم، حدثه عن ابن عمر» : «حدثه» makes Zayd a link (rule 5)
«ثم ذكر قصة الرجم نحو حديث مالك عن نافع» points to another route of the same story: written as a variant with its two names; its own chain is not written here
the Jewish story and the Prophet's words are in the scene; Ibn Umar is the last link
